يتشاجر (form VI)

# يُتَشَاجَرُ (yutašājaru) /ju.ta.ʃaː.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَشَاجَرَ (tašājara)
# يَتَشَاجَرَ (yatašājara) /ja.ta.ʃaː.d͡ʒa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاجَرَ
